title: Keep the app simple. Scale the service.
summary: A customer request leaves the application, reaches a managed service and returns a result. The architecture changes; the customer experience stays familiar.

cues.title: A customer places an order
cues.text: The application owns the experience, not every backend capability.

cues.title: One API boundary
cues.text: Send the request through a stable contract.

cues.title: Move the work, not the customer
cues.text: A managed service handles the backend request.

cues.title: Scale behind the same interface
cues.text: Backend capacity can evolve without changing the application contract.

cues.title: Order confirmed
cues.text: Same customer experience. Independently scalable backend.
